title: 1848 jelképei: kokárda és címer (Symbols of 1848)
grammar: Adverbial Participles, Rhetorical Imperatives & National Symbols Register

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say what the cockade and the tricolour are.
I can say what the red, white and green stand for in the traditional explanation.
I can say what the Kossuth coat of arms is.
I can use six new words about the symbols of 1848, such as kokárda and címer.
